source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Switzerland 2026-27 Puma Home Kit
source.quote: Both the Swiss cross and the SFV crest sit on the chest in white, accompanied by the Puma cat.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as austria-2026-home, germany-2026-home). FSC's launch write-up covers every mark on the shirt and kit: the Swiss cross, SFV crest and Puma cat on the chest, 'suisse' text at the upper neck, red shorts 'finished with white Puma branding' and white socks. No commercial sponsor on any placement. Footy Headlines' release article (3 Dec 2025, https://www.footyheadlines.com/2025/09/switzerland-2026-kits.html) likewise shows only Puma branding and the federation crest on the shirt.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Puma's red 2026 home shirt for Switzerland (2026 World Cup cycle, passport-inspired line pattern) carries only the Swiss cross, the SFV crest and the Puma cat on the chest, plus a small 'suisse' on the upper neck; paired with red shorts with white Puma branding and white socks (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
